create_torchscript_hook: create a TorchscriptHook instance to convert a classy vision model into TorchScript format
trace_model_to_torchscript: trace a PyTorch model using torch.jit.trace to produce a TorchScript module from dummy input
script_model_to_torchscript: script a PyTorch model using torch.jit.script to produce a TorchScript module without tracing
save_torchscript_model: save a TorchScript model to a specified folder as torchscript.pt using PathManager
register_torchscript_hook: register the torchscript hook with classy vision to automatically save models at the end of training
